_about: The 33 short strings of one language (18 interface strings and 15 picture words), keyed by the names in sim/Strings.hpp (Strings::Key). Placeholders: {n} {percent} {title}.
PROVENANCE: machine-translated by a language model from English, terms aligned with the Magic Rampage Companion app, reviewed by a second model pass, NOT by a native speaker.

The four desktop strings of planning step 277 (options.desktop_title, options.fullscreen, options.walk_pads, hint.walk_keys) are machine translations too, checked by a second model pass, with no native reader (LANG-1).
Native review is open (planning step 236, LEFT FOR THE OWNER). A key missing from this file shows the English one, and a placeholder that differs from the English one is refused for that key.

The seven picture.* keys (planning step 247) are machine translations too, with no native reader (LANG-1); none of the seven is a shortened wording chosen for the picture's box; each fits it at a readable size (tests/test_mp_overflow.cpp).

The eight picture.* and credits.* keys of planning step 248 (picture.current_score, picture.golden_score, picture.game_finished, credits.role.design, credits.role.illustration, credits.role.illustration_at, credits.role.modelling, credits.thanks) are machine translations too, with no native reader (LANG-1). picture.game_finished is the card's first paragraph only: a language other than English shows no Facebook line at all, because the Facebook button was omitted on purpose (the owner's choice, option A; the two other options are left open). A space is a place a line may break; in Japanese it is never a gap in the three picture phrases, and the credits phrases keep the spaces round their dashes.
picture.tap_start was "انقر للبدء" (click to start) until planning step 281: a player wrote that Arabic games say اضغط (press), relayed by the owner on 2026-11-27.
